module: Groups the gameplay selector's items into "clusters" (by level, by type or automatically depending on the system) and builds the tile representing each cluster: name, preview, item count, highest favorite/recent, navigation path (gotoPath), source icons. Used by ui_gameplaySelector_general, which must first call setBackend with a backend exposing isFavourite(key) and isRecent(key).
notes: Clustering modes: 'level' (item.level), 'type' (item.type), 'automatic' (according to item.system) and 'none' (everything in "None"). Default value of a group: "Other...".
Automatic mode: campaigns and "Other Gameplay" -> "None" (no grouping); freeroam, scenarios, scenariosMultiplayer -> by level; challenges -> by type; otherwise by level if present.
An item has the form {key, name, preview, system, level, type, ...}; a cluster is {itemsByKey, count, list}.

getClusteredItemsStats: if all items are freeroamSpawnpoint and one is the default start point, its preview is used; if all have the same missionTypeLabel, the mission's default preview is used; with sortMode 'Name' the first by name; otherwise the first found (pairs order, nondeterministic).
clusterItems calls clusterModeFunctions[clusterMode] without a test: an unknown mode raises a Lua error.
No undefined field; M.clusterItems, createTileFromClusteredItems and getClusterModeFunction are defined directly with function M.x, the other three via the "Public API" section.

setBackend.desc: Registers the backend used to know whether an item is a favorite or recent (backend.isFavourite(key), backend.isRecent(key)).

clusterItems.desc: Distributes the items into clusters according to the given mode.

items.desc: Items to group (iterated with pairs), each with a key field.

returns.type: table<string, {itemsByKey: table, count: integer, list: table}>

createTileFromClusteredItems.desc: Builds a cluster's tile according to the mode (level, type or automatic).

group.desc: Parent group: key, gotoParams, isRecentGroup, isFavouriteGroup.

returns.desc: Tile {key, name, preview, subElementCount, favouriteIdx, recentIdx, gotoPath, showFavouriteIconPercent, doubleClickDetails, doubleClickMode, sourceIcons, isAuxiliary, ...}; nil for a mode without a tile ('none').

getClusterModeFunction.desc: Returns the function that gives an item's group name for a mode.

returns.desc: function(item) -> string, nil if mode unknown.
Favorite item with the highest index.

getClusteredItemsStats.desc: Chooses a cluster's representative item and its preview (default image /gameplay/default/preview.jpg).

sortMode.desc: 'Name' to take the first item in alphabetical order.

getSourceIcons.desc: Collects a cluster's source icons (item.sourceIcons) without duplicates, sorted: beamNG, camshaft, puzzleModule, cup, bug first, then the others by name.

returns.desc: List of {svg = path} (if it ends in .svg) or {icon = name}.
